items: A NOT RUN tool result means nothing happened. Repeat the call.
ArtifactData update merges objects but replaces arrays whole. Writes to existing docs need if_version. Batch entries can take file_path to JSON files, which saves retyping big docs.
Artifact 'list' and list_triggers show everything on the account. Check them when the catalog or schedules might be stale.
Artifact read with path 'index.html' saves a page to a file; files over ~16 KB stay out of context, smaller ones come back inline too. A Docs-type artifact's index.html is only the editor shell.
Eastern offset: -04:00 until Nov 1, 2026, then -05:00 until Mar 14, 2027.

The log page source starts at <title>; publishing adds the skeleton. Republishing from a new chat can be refused twice with the live HTML attached; if the file already covers it, the third send goes through.
To test a page against real data: harness/render.py in the repo, fed by ArtifactData list with out_dir (Playwright Chromium is in /opt/pw-browsers).
New scheduled tasks get the account's connectors (Spotify, Claude Docs) attached, and update_trigger can't detach them. Only the prompt keeps a task out of personal apps.

Shell network (tested Oct 12): github.com works (git clone, release downloads); raw.githubusercontent.com, PyPI, npm and the open web don't. pip and npm installs fail, so use preinstalled libraries (pandas 3, pyyaml; no pyarrow). Full map on the Data Desk.
WebFetch reads RSS feeds and returns short JSON verbatim, but refuses some sites (blocked, robots.txt, errors). Never route around a refusal. It reports redirects instead of following them.
An artifact can carry a helper file: publish with files {"desk.py": {from, contentType: "text/plain"}}, then any session gets it with Artifact read path 'desk.py'.

GitHub setup took three steps: link the account in claude.ai connectors (fiddly on mobile), create the repo (sessions can't create repos), and install the Claude GitHub App on the account for pushes. Repo names are case-insensitive in add_repo but list_repos shows the real one. Sessions are bound to attached repos; /user endpoints other than 'gh api user' are refused.
